description: Seeded-error set for the Verifier. Each item is a script sentence, the sentence before it, and a quote locating the chunk the Writer would cite. Errors are seeded by hand: changed numbers, names, or relations; over-generalisation; facts that are true in the world but absent from the materials; misleading framing. Items tagged hard add subtler cases, each with one error-type tag: causal claims the source does not make, dropped hedges, scope and binding swaps, wrong arithmetic, false presuppositions in questions, context-dependent pronouns, and correct sentences that need inference or heavy paraphrase. Items tagged dialogue come from two-host scripts: a speaker and a previous line by the other host, with claims split across the two (short answers, agreements, restatements).
